target: Rediseño visual autorizado de fauna natural no combatiente de los Llanos de Edran; romper por completo la lectura dinosauriana antes de integrar a runtime.
art_direction: REDISEÑO VISUAL AUTORIZADO. Mantener la locomoción 4+2 y la adaptación al viento, pero abandonar la silueta previa. El Velozanco debe parecer un animal original de llanura construido alrededor de un cuerpo central bajo, ancho y suspendido, parecido en masa a una semilla o cápsula orgánica aplanada, no a un torso vertebrado con pecho, cuello y caderas. Seis apoyos nacen alrededor de la masa corporal: cuatro patas locomotoras largas y delgadas distribuidas en dos pares equilibrados y dos apoyos anteriores más cortos. Cabeza pequeña, roma y baja, parcialmente encajada bajo el borde frontal del cuerpo, sin cuello visible. Sin cola corporal reconocible: sólo dos cortos filamentos rígidos sensoriales emergen juntos del borde posterior. Sobre el lomo existe una banda membranosa blanda, baja y plegada por el viento, nunca una vela. Fauna ambiental, tímida y veloz. Paleta fría/neutra de Edran. CORRECCIÓN OBLIGATORIA TRAS v004: los dos apoyos anteriores cortos deben ser patas rígidas visibles que TERMINAN EN EL SUELO, con puntos de contacto inequívocos y pequeñas sombras de contacto; no pueden colgar del vientre. Los dos filamentos posteriores deben ser diminutos muñones sensoriales rígidos pegados al borde posterior, nunca prolongaciones tipo cola. PASADA DE DETALLE: sin añadir órganos ni cambiar la silueta canónica, elevar el acabado biológico. La piel debe mostrar variación funcional: micropliegues suaves alrededor de las articulaciones y vientre, tensión más lisa sobre el lomo expuesto al viento y leves cambios de espesor donde nacen las seis patas. Las patas largas deben tener articulaciones legibles y tendones discretos bajo la piel, con extremos compactos de apoyo adaptados a suelo firme de llanura. Los dos apoyos anteriores cortos deben parecer estructuralmente capaces de cargar peso, con articulación, pie pequeño y compresión visible al tocar el suelo. La membrana dorsal debe mostrar borde fino, pequeñas arrugas de tensión y una inserción orgánica continua en el lomo. La cabeza encajada debe incluir ojos laterales pequeños y protegidos y aberturas respiratorias discretas, sin crear hocico. Los dos filamentos posteriores deben verse como estructuras sensoriales rígidas de base engrosada, no como cola.
prompt: Create one original alien-but-natural plains animal for Vintage Telnet, shown completely in a low three-quarter side view in the Llanos de Edran. DESIGN FROM A NEW SILHOUETTE; do not imitate the previous reference image. Start from a broad, low, flattened seed-pod-shaped CENTRAL BODY suspended above the ground. The body must read as one continuous oval/capsule mass with NO chest, NO pelvis emphasis, NO upright torso and NO visible neck. Arrange exactly SIX weight-bearing supports around this central mass: four very long, slender locomotor legs in two balanced pairs, with the front and rear pair similar in visual importance, plus two noticeably shorter auxiliary supports near the lower front quarter. All six are legs/supports, never arms. The tiny blunt head is tucked low into the underside/front rim of the central body, almost like a sensory prow: broad and rounded, no muzzle, no beak, no reptile skull, no neck. At the rear there is NO conventional fleshy tail. Instead, exactly TWO short rigid sensory filaments project directly from the rear edge of the body, each much shorter than a leg. Across the upper body lies a LOW SOFT DORSAL MEMBRANE like a flexible strip of skin pressed flat sideways by the crosswind; it is not triangular and does not rise above the body as a sail. Give the animal smooth matte hide with subtle longitudinal folds, no scales and no armor. Pose it moving laterally with all six supports clearly understandable and the body staying level, like a wind-adapted ground runner rather than a predator. Natural cautious non-combat behavior. Background subordinate: muted green-gray field margins, blue-gray overcast sky, brown-gray soil and only sparse pale straw. Cool neutral daylight. The finished silhouette should be recognizable even as a black shape: low central capsule, four balanced stilts, two short front supports, tiny tucked-under head, and two tiny rear filaments. CRITICAL GEOMETRY FOR NEXT ATTEMPT: show BOTH short anterior auxiliary legs fully from their attachment points to the ground. EACH of the two short front supports MUST visibly TOUCH the ground with a small foot/contact tip and a contact shadow; place them slightly separated left/right so neither is hidden by perspective or by a long leg. They are short rigid load-bearing legs, NOT dangling appendages. CRITICAL REAR: the TWO posterior sensory filaments must be TINY STUBS only, no more than roughly one-tenth of a long leg length, projecting only a very short distance from the rear body rim. They must NOT create any tail silhouette. DETAIL PASS WITHOUT CHANGING THE FROZEN ANATOMY: increase biological specificity and material realism. Show subtle skin behavior across the animal: smoother taut hide across the wind-facing dorsal surface, shallow compression folds under the belly, and fine flexible creases around every leg attachment. Each of the four long legs should have readable but non-mammalian joint transitions and faint tendon tension beneath the matte hide; keep them slender, organic and unarmored. Their distal ends should terminate in compact stable ground-contact pads/toes suited to firm plains soil, not hooves or bird feet. Give each short anterior support a clearly engineered-by-evolution load-bearing structure: visible joint, short lower segment, compact foot and slight skin compression where weight reaches the ground. The dorsal membrane must be visibly thin and soft, with a continuous fleshy attachment along the back, a fine flexible edge and several shallow wind-tension wrinkles pressed in one consistent direction. Add two small protected lateral eyes to the tucked head plus tiny unobtrusive breathing openings; preserve the blunt head with absolutely no muzzle. Around the underside/front rim, use subtle sensory skin texture rather than whiskers or antennae. At the rear, give each of the exactly two tiny rigid sensory stubs a slightly thickened organic base and fine surface striation while keeping both extremely short. Add restrained natural variation in the cool gray-green hide: slightly darker joints/underside and a desaturated lighter dorsal plane, never decorative stripes or bright markings. Include realistic contact shadows beneath all six supports and a small amount of dust/flattened grass reacting to the feet and crosswind. Render enough close biological detail that the creature feels like a living species rather than a smooth concept-model, while the silhouette remains the same low capsule 4+2 design.
negative_constraints: ABSOLUTELY NO dinosaur, theropod, raptor, ornithopod, bird, lizard or reptile silhouette
No conventional vertebrate body plan with distinct chest, long neck, pelvis-heavy rear or counterbalancing tail
No visible neck; head must be tiny, blunt and tucked into the lower front edge of the body
No snout, muzzle, beak, reptilian skull, teeth or predatory face
No conventional tail; only exactly two short rigid rear sensory filaments emerging directly from the body edge
No bipedal impression and no oversized rear legs; front and rear long leg pairs must carry equal visual weight
Exactly six weight-bearing supports: four long locomotor legs plus two short anterior supports
No insect exoskeleton, segmented abdomen, antennae or arthropod head
No feathers, wings, dorsal sail, rigid fin, spikes, horns or armor
No dominant ochre, amber, yellow or golden palette; pale straw may appear only as a minor background accent
No sunset or golden-hour lighting
No attack pose, glow, magic, readable text or HUD
No hanging front appendages: both short anterior supports must visibly reach and contact the ground
No hidden/occluded short supports: both must be separately readable with ground contact and contact shadow
Rear filaments must be tiny stubs, approximately <=10% of a long leg length; never tail-length
No featureless smooth concept-model finish; include subtle functional skin, joint and membrane detail
No mammalian hooves, bird feet, reptile scales or insect joints
No decorative stripes, spots, bright warning colors or ornamental markings
No whiskers or antennae; sensory detail stays on skin and the two canonical rear stubs
No new fins, crests, extra membranes, extra digits or additional sensory organs
Do not increase the size of the head, dorsal membrane or rear sensory stubs while adding detail

notes: Rediseño fuerte autorizado tras fallos repetidos de lectura dinosauriana. Se retira deliberadamente la imagen de Fase 1 como referencia porque estaba anclando las nuevas generaciones a la silueta rechazada. Se conserva la función regional C0, el esquema locomotor 4+2, la adaptación al viento y los dos filamentos posteriores, pero se reconstruye la masa corporal desde una cápsula baja no vertebrada visualmente. No publicar hasta superar autocrítica. v004 narrowed the remaining failures to ground contact of both short anterior supports and excessive rear-filament length; next generation explicitly locks those geometries. Detail pass requested by Javier: enrich biological surface, joints, feet, membrane tension, tucked-head sensory anatomy and contact with terrain without altering frozen 4+2 silhouette.
